title: Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Customize global and in-app keyboard shortcuts.
globalDescription: Shortcuts that work system-wide even when Knovum is in the background.
dictationDescription: Global push-to-talk: hold to record speech, release to transcribe and type.
dictationTip: Scenario: Hold this shortcut to speak in any application (e.g. browser, editor, document); release to transcribe and type text at your cursor.
conflictWarning: This global shortcut could not be registered because it is in use by another application or the system.
inAppConflict: This shortcut is already used by "{command}".
